filters.dql: | lookup [fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "transcript" | fields request_id=ratexp.request_id, business_case=ratexp.business_case, language=ratexp.language, task_type=ratexp.task_type], sourceField:ratexp.request_id, lookupField:request_id, prefix:"label." | filter matchesValue(coalesce(ratexp.skill_name, "(none)"), $skill) and matchesValue(splitString(ratexp.agent, " ")[0], $agent) and matchesValue(coalesce(ratexp.eval_name, "(none)"), $eval) and matchesValue(coalesce(label.business_case, "(none)"), $business_case) and matchesValue(coalesce(label.language, "(none)"), $language) and matchesValue(coalesce(label.task_type, "(none)"), $task_type)

values.skill: data record(skill="*") | append [fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" | summarize count(), by:{skill=coalesce(ratexp.skill_name, "(none)")} | fields skill | sort skill asc]
values.agent: data record(agent="*") | append [fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" | summarize count(), by:{agent=splitString(ratexp.agent, " ")[0]} | fields agent | sort agent asc]
values.eval: data record(eval="*") | append [fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" | summarize count(), by:{eval=coalesce(ratexp.eval_name, "(none)")} | fields eval | sort eval asc]
values.business_case: data record(business_case="*") | append [fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "transcript" | summarize count(), by:{business_case=coalesce(ratexp.business_case, "(none)")} | fields business_case | sort business_case asc]
values.language: data record(language="*") | append [fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "transcript" | summarize count(), by:{language=coalesce(ratexp.language, "(none)")} | fields language | sort language asc]
values.task_type: data record(task_type="*") | append [fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "transcript" | summarize count(), by:{task_type=coalesce(ratexp.task_type, "(none)")} | fields task_type | sort task_type asc]

download.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" {filters} | sort timestamp desc | limit 1000 | fields created_at=timestamp, session_id=ratexp.session_id, skill_name=ratexp.skill_name, agent=ratexp.agent, eval_name=ratexp.eval_name, score=ratexp.score, comment=ratexp.comment, request_id=ratexp.request_id, business_case=label.business_case, language=label.language, task_type=label.task_type

panels.title: Total ratings
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" {filters} | summarize value=count()

panels.title: Percent good
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" and isNotNull(ratexp.score) {filters} | summarize good=countIf(ratexp.score == 1), bad=countIf(ratexp.score == 2) | fieldsAdd value=round(100.0 * good / (good + bad), decimals:1) | fields value

panels.title: Ratings in the last 24h
panels.dql: fetch logs, from:now()-24h | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" {filters} | summarize value=count()

panels.title: Skills rated
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" and isNotNull(ratexp.skill_name) {filters} | summarize value=countDistinct(ratexp.skill_name)

panels.title: Good vs bad per day
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" {filters} | summarize good=countIf(ratexp.score == 1), bad=countIf(ratexp.score == 2), by:{day=bin(timestamp, 1d)} | sort day asc

panels.title: Percent good by skill (worst first)
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" and isNotNull(ratexp.score) and isNotNull(ratexp.skill_name) {filters} | summarize total=count(), good=countIf(ratexp.score == 1), bad=countIf(ratexp.score == 2), by:{name=ratexp.skill_name} | fieldsAdd percent_good=round(100.0 * good / total, decimals:1) | sort percent_good asc, total desc | limit 10

panels.title: Percent good by agent (worst first)
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" and isNotNull(ratexp.score) {filters} | summarize total=count(), good=countIf(ratexp.score == 1), bad=countIf(ratexp.score == 2), by:{name=splitString(ratexp.agent, " ")[0]} | fieldsAdd percent_good=round(100.0 * good / total, decimals:1) | sort percent_good asc, total desc | limit 10

panels.title: Percent good by eval (worst first)
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" and isNotNull(ratexp.score) {filters} | summarize total=count(), good=countIf(ratexp.score == 1), bad=countIf(ratexp.score == 2), by:{name=coalesce(ratexp.eval_name, "(none)")} | fieldsAdd percent_good=round(100.0 * good / total, decimals:1) | sort percent_good asc, total desc | limit 10

panels.title: Latest comments
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "feedback" and isNotNull(ratexp.comment) and ratexp.comment != "" {filters} | sort timestamp desc | limit 10 | fields created_at=timestamp, name=coalesce(ratexp.skill_name, ratexp.session_id), agent=ratexp.agent, eval_name=ratexp.eval_name, rating=ratexp.rating, comment=ratexp.comment

panels.title: Sessions: labels, steps, tool calls, tokens, model
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "transcript" {filters} | sort timestamp desc | limit 10 | fields created_at=timestamp, skill_name=ratexp.skill_name, agent=ratexp.agent, model=ratexp.model, business_case=ratexp.business_case, language=ratexp.language, task_type=ratexp.task_type, steps=ratexp.steps, tool_calls=ratexp.tool_calls, prompt_tokens=ratexp.prompt_tokens, cached_tokens=ratexp.cached_tokens, completion_tokens=ratexp.completion_tokens, session_id=ratexp.session_id

panels.title: Conversations (full trajectories)
panels.dql: fetch logs | filter ratexp.record_type == "transcript" {filters} | sort timestamp desc | limit 50 | fields created_at=timestamp, skill_name=ratexp.skill_name, agent=ratexp.agent, session_id=ratexp.session_id, request_id=ratexp.request_id, content
